instruction_only_followup.method: 125 Hz wall-clock instruction-pointer samples per selected thread; bounded suspension, context read and unconditional resume; no target-memory reads, stack reads or dumps
instruction_only_followup.attribution: Installed plugin COFF symbols and local system-library exported ranges/disassembly
instruction_only_followup.interpretation: Leaf concentrations after locked counter updates and inside shared-SRW CAS/retry/backoff paths support contention in per-binding bookkeeping. The counter, replay gate and frequently read tracking/owner state also share one cache line.
instruction_only_followup.limits: Wall-clock leaves include blocked states and are not CPU-time percentages. No callers were captured, so blocked waits cannot be attributed to the replay gate, game jobs, GPU completion or frame pacing. Earlier Standard sampling was shorter and used a different process/build; rough context only.
